part.text:
All tests pass and TypeScript compiles cleanly. Here's the project structure:

```
src/
├── cli.ts           # CLI entry (npx ssg build --content <dir> --output <dir>)
├── parser.ts        # Reads .md files, parses frontmatter + markdown
├── generator.ts     # Generates index.html + per-page HTML files
├── types.ts         # Page, Frontmatter interfaces
├── index.ts         # Public API exports
└── __tests__/
    ├── parser.test.ts
    ├── generator.test.ts
    └── cli.test.ts
```

Key decisions:
- `grey-matter` parses frontmatter, `marked` converts markdown to HTML
- Date fields are normalized (handles both YAML `Date` objects and strings)
- Pages sorted alphabetically by title in the index
- HTML escaping prevents XSS in titles
- Missing frontmatter fields default to empty strings/arrays
